english.note: Use 剩低嘅部分 for the part or amount that remains, especially when referring to an agreement, task, or collection rather than an account.

exampleSentences.english: The balance of the work can be done tomorrow.
exampleSentences.traditional: 剩低嘅部分聽日先做都得。
